title: Daily Prices Collection
description: Buying (from vendor) and selling (to customer) prices per vegetable per day. Collection: prices. Document ID: {veg_id}_{YYYY-MM-DD} for easy querying.

id.description: Composite document ID — format: {veg_id}_{YYYY-MM-DD}, e.g. abc123_2026-06-20

veg_name_en.description: Denormalized vegetable name in English for faster reads

veg_name_te.description: Denormalized vegetable name in Telugu for display

buy_price.description: Price paid to vendor per unit (in INR)

sell_price.description: Price charged to customer per unit (in INR)

unit.description: Unit for which buy/sell prices apply

margin.description: Derived field: sell_price - buy_price (can be stored for quick access)

created_at.description: Firestore Timestamp — when price was set
